response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS overall_avg FROM j), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM j GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rate, AVG(ch.avg_rate - overall.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM ch CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ch.avg_rate > overall.overall_avg
